title: Steak Salad with {v}
steps: Pat the {p} dry, season with the {spice} and salt, and sear in a very hot pan 3 to 4 minutes a side. Check the thickest part with a thermometer: the USDA safe minimum for steak is 145°F / 63°C. A lower doneness is your choice and carries more risk.
Rest the {p} 3 to 5 minutes on a clean plate, then slice thin against the grain.
Toss the {v} with the {sauce} and pile onto plates.
Top with the sliced steak and serve with the {s}.
tip: Make the salad mostly veg, use a light dressing, and slice the steak thin so a small piece goes a long way.
